entities.name: grubber
entities.release: Live read service at bd-grubber.fly.dev; M4 APNs device registration/push, fast topic updates, and the public live progress view are deployed
entities.description: Transcript-oriented read service exposing HTTP, MCP, and a staged podcast-versus-news analysis pipeline.
notes: Public API and MCP are treated as the stable contract.
M2 adds idempotent embeddings, topic clustering, daily rollups, and /api/v1/trending plus /api/v1/topics/{topic_id}.
M3 adds budget-gated LLM labels, claim comparisons, and markdown or JSON daily digests at /api/v1/digest/today and /api/v1/digest/{yyyy-mm-dd}.
M4 adds APNs device registration and producer-side dispatch; current live reads include /api/v1/updates/recent, /api/v1/topics/{topic_id}/compare, and /progress.
The Mac producer runs text, audio, fast-analysis, and full-analysis launchd lanes; the analysis lanes use one SQLite lock to prevent concurrent-writer failures.

sentipods README.md states the Mac bundle is com.sentipods.mac, but project.yml sets the SentipodsMac target to com.sentipods.app - one universal-purchase record, not two apps. README is stale.

Resolved. Oenora and SharedSpaceLab now build for Mac Catalyst (SUPPORTS_MACCATALYST=YES, DERIVE_MACCATALYST_PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER=NO), so their existing macOS ASC records can receive builds under the same bundle ID. Both verified with 'xcodebuild -destination platform=macOS,variant=Mac Catalyst'. Catalyst was chosen over native AppKit because both view layers are UIKit-coupled.
MastPex IOS and MastPex Mac have no corresponding repository; owner describes both as placeholders.

GigStand (com.billdonner.gigstand, app ID 428849240) shipped 2011-05-04 and was dead for ~15 years. Apple does not permit deleting an app that has ever been on sale, which is why it could not be removed through the ASC UI. Removed from sale instead: all 175 territoryAvailabilities set available=false on 2026-08-13. The record and its version history remain in ASC permanently and will still appear in any full app listing - this is expected, not a gap to re-investigate. Two residuals: the abandoned 1.10 draft from 2011-08-10 cannot be deleted ('Only the first version of any platform can be deleted'), and appAvailabilities does not allow UPDATE, so availableInNewTerritories remains true - if Apple adds a brand-new territory, GigStand could auto-list there and would need removing again.

All 6 real macOS records have primary category and copyright. Age rating set for Mallinbook, Pfoliolio, Screenker; still UNSET for Oenora, SharedSpaceLab, SentiPods pending owner judgment (wine subject matter, peer-to-peer chat, and unfiltered third-party content respectively). SentiPods desktop screenshots uploaded 2026-08-13 (3 at 2880x1800, assetDeliveryState COMPLETE). Mallinbook still has no build on its macOS record.
